ttlCacheDesignNote: backend/src/shared/cache/ttlCache.ts exposes only get/set/clear() — no per-key delete. Every 'invalidation' in the codebase is a full clear() wiping all entries (all users/filters), not just the mutated row. Correct for safety (never serves stale cross-user data longer than necessary) but inefficient for hit-rate (one user's write clears everyone's cache for that resource). Not a bug in any of the ~34 caches — a design characteristic worth considering if a new shared helper is extracted in 14I.3.
